name: EPIC 220190886
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.8 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,073 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.90 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,983 K at its surface.
